[HUST X RIKKEISOFT KÝ KẾT HỢP TÁC CHIẾN LƯỢC: RA MẮT HỆ SINH THÁI ĐÀO TẠO DỮ LIỆU THẾ HỆ MỚI DATA ANALYSIS VÀ DATA ENGINEERING ĐÓN ĐẦU LÀN SÓNG AI]
Sự bùng nổ của Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) đang làm thay đổi căn bản cấu trúc thị trường lao động. Trong khi các vị trí lập trình truyền thống đối mặt với làn sóng bão hòa, dữ liệu lại trở thành nền tảng cốt lõi cho mọi quyết định của doanh nghiệp. Để ứng dụng AI thành công, doanh nghiệp bắt buộc phải có hạ tầng dữ liệu sạch và đội ngũ nhân sự biết cách khai phá dữ liệu đó. Nhằm cung cấp nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao đón đầu xu hướng này, Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số (BK Fintech) - Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội hợp tác cùng Rikkei Education ra mắt hai chương trình đào tạo dữ liệu mũi nhọn: 1️⃣ DATA ANALYSIS (Phân tích Dữ liệu): Chương trình đã khẳng định uy tín vượt trội qua 32 khóa đào tạo liên tục. Lộ trình học 5.5 tháng dành cho nhân sự thuộc mọi lĩnh vực, giúp người trái ngành dễ dàng làm chủ công cụ truy vấn (SQL, Python, Power BI) và tích hợp AI để tối ưu hóa hiệu suất phân tích. 2️⃣ AI-NATIVE DATA ENGINEER (Kỹ sư Dữ liệu tích hợp AI): Lộ trình học 5.5 tháng dành riêng cho dân IT (Backend, DBA, DevOps) muốn chuyển ngành.

[Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Advance the Innovation Ecosystem]
On 24 July 2026, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy at Hanoi University of Science and Technology and A-Star X officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding. The agreement marks a new milestone in the partnership between the two organisations, with a shared commitment to strengthening connections among education, research, product development and the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem. The signing ceremony was held as part of broader efforts to promote collaboration among universities, businesses and the technology community. Under the Memorandum of Understanding, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X will collaborate on practice-oriented training programmes, research activities, professional workshops, mentoring initiatives, hackathons, product development and industry engagement. A key focus of the partnership is the joint operation and development of BKFintech Hackday and BKFintech Founder in Residence. These initiatives are designed to provide students, product development teams and aspiring founders with opportunities to address real-world challenges, receive guidance from experienced professionals and gradually transform their ideas into practical and scalable solutions.

content:
[Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Advance the Innovation Ecosystem > Connecting academic education with innovation practice]
As technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain and Web3 continue to reshape economic, financial and business activities, the requirements for technology professionals are extending beyond technical knowledge. Students and young builders must also develop problem-solving skills, interdisciplinary capabilities, product thinking and a strong understanding of market needs. The partnership between the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X is expected to help narrow the gap between academic knowledge and industry requirements. Through jointly organised programmes, students will be able to engage with real-life cases, data and business challenges at an early stage of their education. They will also have opportunities to interact directly with specialists, business leaders and founders while improving their research, solution-design and technology product development capabilities. In addition to training and knowledge-sharing activities, the two organisations plan to promote mentoring programmes, professional meetups, product incubation, hackathons and connections between project teams and industry partners. These activities are intended not only to strengthen students’ professional competencies but also to enable promising ideas to be tested, refined and connected with appropriate resources.

content:
[Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Advance the Innovation Ecosystem > Joint operation of BKFintech Hackday]
BKFintech Hackday is designed as an experimental and product-development environment for students, developers and technology teams. By addressing challenges proposed by businesses and industry specialists, participants can apply their knowledge to develop solutions related to digital finance, artificial intelligence, blockchain and Web3 technologies. Under the partnership, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X will work together to develop programme content and engage specialists, mentors and corporate partners. The joint operation of BKFintech Hackday is expected to enhance the practical relevance of its challenges, create further opportunities for post-programme product development and strengthen connections between young technology teams and the wider innovation ecosystem. Rather than functioning solely as a competition, BKFintech Hackday is intended to provide a comprehensive learning journey. Participants will be encouraged to identify problems, examine user needs, develop prototypes, validate solutions and present their products to a panel of experts. Through this process, the programme will support the development of product thinking, teamwork skills and the ability to translate ideas into solutions with practical value.

content:
[Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Advance the Innovation Ecosystem > Development of BKFintech Founder in Residence]
Alongside BKFintech Hackday, the two organisations will collaborate on the development of BKFintech Founder in Residence, a programme that connects founders, technology specialists and professionals who are actively building businesses with the university environment. The programme aims to bring practical experience in product development, business model design, team management, resource mobilisation and market expansion closer to students. Through discussions, mentoring sessions and project-based engagement, participants will gain insight not only into business and technology knowledge but also into how founders identify problems, make decisions and adapt their products throughout the business development process. BKFintech Founder in Residence also serves as a bridge between research and application, between ideas and products, and between students and the wider community of specialists, businesses and investors. The involvement of A-Star X is expected to expand the network of mentors, partners and supporting resources available to project teams and aspiring founders.

content:
[Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Advance the Innovation Ecosystem > Building a sustainable collaborative ecosystem]
The Institute for Digital Technology and Economy recognises that a sustainable innovation ecosystem cannot be created through a single competition, workshop or short-term initiative. Such an ecosystem requires long-term collaboration among universities, businesses, experts, founders, investors and the broader technology community. The signing of the Memorandum of Understanding with A-Star X provides a foundation for the two organisations to develop substantive and long-term programmes covering education, research, human resource development, product building, project incubation and market connectivity. Each activity implemented under the partnership will create further opportunities for students to learn, experiment and strengthen their capabilities as they gradually develop into future builders and founders. Following the signing, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and A-Star X will continue to translate the agreed areas of cooperation into specific initiatives, with an initial focus on the joint operation of BKFintech Hackday and BKFintech Founder in Residence. Both organisations expect these programmes to generate meaningful value for students, the technology community and the broader innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem.

[UNIHACKFEST 2026 – HANOI CAMPUS WORKSHOP BRINGS TOGETHER LEADING EXPERTS IN AI, BLOCKCHAIN, AND WEB3]
The UniHackfest 2026 – Hanoi Campus Workshop brings together experts who are actively involved in product development, ecosystem building, and innovation across the fields of AI, Blockchain, and Web3. The event is expected to offer students practical insights into emerging technology trends, product development thinking, and the journey of transforming an initial idea into a solution with real-world value. The workshop will take place from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on 24 July 2026 at the HUST – MB Digital Hub, Hanoi University of Science and Technology. A strong idea can provide a valuable starting point. However, turning that idea into a practical product requires the right mindset, a clear understanding of user needs, and access to real-world experience from the market. The speakers at UniHackfest 2026 – Hanoi Campus are not merely observers of technological change. They are professionals who are directly involved in building products, developing communities, and advancing innovation in AI, Blockchain, and Web3. Drawing on their practical experience and diverse perspectives from both industry and technology communities, the speakers will help students gain a deeper understanding of market trends, product development strategies, and the process of transforming an early-stage idea into a viable solution.

[UNIHACKFEST 2026 – HANOI CAMPUS WORKSHOP BRINGS TOGETHER LEADING EXPERTS IN AI, BLOCKCHAIN, AND WEB3 > Ms. Theon – Brand Manager, MEXC Ventures Vietnam]
With more than four years of experience in Brand Marketing, Communications, Project Management, and Market Development, Ms. Theon currently represents MEXC in digital communications, community development, and the organisation of locally tailored Blockchain and FinTech events in Vietnam. In the rapidly evolving Web3 landscape, strong technology alone is not enough to ensure the success of a product. A product must also be clearly positioned, communicated through a compelling message, and supported by a sustainable user community. At the UniHackfest 2026 – Hanoi Campus Workshop, Ms. Theon will share practical insights into Web3 marketing, product branding, community development, and strategies for connecting products with the right target users. Her session will help participating teams improve the way they present their ideas, identify their unique value propositions, and strengthen their market reach.

Through these insights, he aims to inspire students as they begin their journey towards becoming the technology builders and product developers of the future.

[CONGRATULATIONS TO DR. DO BA LAM ON HIS APPOINTMENT AS VICE DIRECTOR OF THE INSTITUTE FOR DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND ECONOMY]
The Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, extends its warmest congratulations to Dr. Do Ba Lam on his appointment as Vice Director of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy. On 10 July 2026, Hanoi University of Science and Technology held its Mid-Year Review Conference to assess the University’s performance during the first six months of 2026 and outline key priorities for the remainder of the year. As part of the conference, appointment decisions were officially presented to newly appointed managers of the University’s affiliated units. On this occasion, Dr. Do Ba Lam was entrusted with the position of Vice Director of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy. Dr. Do Ba Lam is currently a lecturer in the Department of Computer Science, School of Information and Communication Technology, Hanoi University of Science and Technology. He received his PhD in Computer Science from TU Wien, Austria, in 2017. His main research interests include blockchain technology, the Semantic Web, digital signatures, data integration, and knowledge graphs. Throughout his teaching and research career, Dr. Do Ba Lam has participated in numerous research projects and digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the fields of blockchain technology, digital diplomas and certificates, digital signature systems, data integration, and the development of digital platforms for education. He has also been an active contributor to the research activities of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, helping to strengthen the connection between technology, economics, and practical applications.

[Cyber Clinic Train-the-Trainer: Enhancing Lecturers’ Capacity to Support Businesses in the Digital Era]
As digital transformation continues to accelerate, the need to develop high-quality human resources in information security has become increasingly urgent. To help address this challenge, Hanoi University of Science and Technology is implementing the Cybersecurity Human Resources Incubator in the Digital Economy – Cyber Clinic project, with support from The Asia Foundation (TAF) and funding from Google.org. The project aims to establish and operate the Cyber Clinic as an incubator for training, support, and knowledge sharing in information security, while promoting lifelong learning for students, lecturers, businesses, and the wider community. It also focuses on training young professionals with technical expertise, practical skills, and advisory capabilities in information security, enabling them to support micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). The project is being implemented in several provinces and cities, including Hanoi, Quang Ninh, Dien Bien, Lao Cai, Thanh Hoa, Da Nang, and Can Tho. As one of the project’s key activities, the Train-the-Trainer Programme was held at the MB Digital Hub, with the participation of experts, lecturers, and representatives of partner organisations. The programme brought together leading experts in information security, law, and education to develop a team of lecturers with strong professional expertise and modern teaching methods.

content:
[Cyber Clinic Train-the-Trainer: Enhancing Lecturers’ Capacity to Support Businesses in the Digital Era > An Overview of Information Security in the Digital Economy]
The first training session was delivered by Mr. Ngo Tuan Anh, Deputy Head of Data Security and Personal Data Protection at the Vietnam Cybersecurity Experts Network/Alliance (NCA). The session provided a comprehensive overview of information security in the digital economy and the challenges faced by small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). According to Mr. Ngo tuan Anh, one of the greatest barriers is that many small and medium-sized enterprises still believe that they are not targets of cyberattacks. He presented evidence from both domestic and international reports and studies. Notably, according to a report by the National Cybersecurity Association, 46.15% of organisations and businesses in Vietnam reported having experienced at least one cyberattack during the previous year. These figures show that cyberattacks are occurring with increasing frequency and are becoming more sophisticated and unpredictable, ranging from ransomware and advanced persistent threats (APTs) to online fraud and data breaches. In addition to analysing cyberattack trends, Mr. Ngô Tuấn Anh introduced an approach to developing training content for lecturers based on the National Data Architecture Framework, combined with the principles of Security by Design. Under this approach, information security should be integrated from the system design and development stages, rather than being treated only as a response after an incident has occurred. This approach helps develop a proactive security mindset and provides lecturers with a foundation for guiding businesses in building information security solutions from the outset.

content:
[Cyber Clinic Train-the-Trainer: Enhancing Lecturers’ Capacity to Support Businesses in the Digital Era > Addressing the Challenges of Enterprise Data Protection]
The programme continued with a session delivered by Mr. Lưu Xuân Vĩnh, Managing Lawyer at Asia Legal, who presented legal and governance perspectives on enterprise data protection. He introduced legal frameworks and data protection principles currently applied worldwide and analysed the development of Vietnam’s legal system in information security and personal data protection. He also provided updates on new provisions of the 2025 Law on Cybersecurity and the requirements placed on businesses in relation to compliance and data governance. Mr. Luu Xuan Vinh emphasised that data protection is not only a compliance requirement but also an important factor in building trust with customers and partners and improving business competitiveness in the digital economy. As Vietnam aims for the digital economy to contribute approximately 30% of GDP by 2030, establishing a safe and trustworthy digital environment will provide an important foundation for promoting innovation and sustainable development.

content:
[Cyber Clinic Train-the-Trainer: Enhancing Lecturers’ Capacity to Support Businesses in the Digital Era > Introducing the Internationally Aligned Cyber Clinic Training Framework]
In the final session, Dr. Vũ Văn Thiệu, lecturer at the Faculty of Computer Science, School of Information and Communication Technology (SoICT), Hanoi University of Science and Technology, introduced the Cyber Clinic training framework developed based on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF). The framework is designed to help lecturers gain an overall understanding of the curriculum and practical activities for learners and students participating in the Cybersecurity Human Resources Incubator in the Digital Economy project. The programme consists of nine training sessions, including seven modules on information security and two modules on soft skills. The information security content focuses on core competencies such as identifying and assessing information security risks for small and medium-sized enterprises; implementing measures to protect accounts, data, and devices; developing incident response procedures and backup plans; and establishing information security policies in accordance with current legal regulations. In addition to technical knowledge, the programme places emphasis on practical activities through simulated scenarios, group exercises, and discussions with experts. This approach helps learners not only understand information security principles but also apply them in practice, gradually developing a risk management mindset and building an information security culture within businesses. Discussing the project’s future direction, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nguyễn Thị Xuân Hòa, Deputy Director of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy and Project Lead of the Cyber Clinic Incubator, stated that the Cyber Clinic aims to recruit and train between 80 and 100 students with backgrounds in information security and digital transformation.

These students will support and provide consultancy to approximately 200 micro and small enterprises, household businesses, and social organisations in the localities where the project is implemented. In particular, all participants will receive full financial support for training, accommodation, and travel expenses, enabling young people from different regions to access high-quality training and support businesses in achieving safe and sustainable digital transformation. Feedback from the participants will provide an important basis for further improving the Cyber Clinic curriculum, developing a core team of lecturers, and promoting good information security practices within the business community.

HACK <CX> IN BANKING TOGETHER 2026 là cuộc thi đổi mới sáng tạo và Hackathon công nghệ trong lĩnh vực tài chính – ngân hàng, quy tụ sinh viên, nhà phát triển và những người trẻ đam mê công nghệ nhằm phát triển các giải pháp ứng dụng AI, dữ liệu, công nghệ số và tư duy sản phẩm để nâng cao trải nghiệm khách hàng, tối ưu vận hành và thúc đẩy đổi mới sáng tạo trong ngành ngân hàng. Không chỉ là một sân chơi trí tuệ, cuộc thi còn mở ra cơ hội để các đội thi tiếp cận trực tiếp với nhu cầu thực tiễn của doanh nghiệp, phát triển sản phẩm mẫu, thử nghiệm ý tưởng và kết nối với hệ sinh thái chuyên gia, cố vấn trong lĩnh vực tài chính, ngân hàng, công nghệ và đổi mới sáng tạo. Năm 2026, cuộc thi ghi nhận những con số ấn tượng với 332 thí sinh, 86 đội thi, 134 ý tưởng, 33 đội Early Bird và sự tham gia của 33 trường đại học. Từ các ý tưởng dự thi, Ban Tổ chức đã lựa chọn các đội xuất sắc bước vào vòng Chung kết Hackathon trực tiếp tại Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, nơi các đội làm việc liên tục trong 36 giờ để phát triển giải pháp, xây dựng sản phẩm mẫu và trình bày trước Hội đồng Giám khảo.

content:
[HACK <CX> IN BANKING TOGETHER 2026 KHÉP LẠI SAU 36 GIỜ HACKATHON: VINH DANH NHỮNG GIẢI PHÁP CÔNG NGHỆ SÁNG TẠO TRONG LĨNH VỰC NGÂN HÀNG > Biến giảng đường thành không gian thử nghiệm thực tiễn]
Phát biểu tại chương trình, PGS.TS. Huỳnh Quyết Thắng, Phó Giám đốc Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, nhấn mạnh giá trị lớn nhất của cuộc thi là giúp sinh viên rèn luyện khả năng làm việc cường độ cao, hợp tác, sáng tạo và biến ý tưởng thành sản phẩm trong thời gian ngắn. Theo PGS.TS. Huỳnh Quyết Thắng, trong bối cảnh trí tuệ nhân tạo đang làm thay đổi mạnh mẽ lĩnh vực công nghệ số và ngân hàng, các ý tưởng sáng tạo cần được kết nối để trở thành những sản phẩm phục vụ cuộc sống. Ông cũng kỳ vọng sinh viên các trường đại học sẽ tiếp tục cùng nhau tạo ra những sản phẩm có giá trị thực tiễn, từ đó hình thành các dự án khởi nghiệp và doanh nghiệp có năng lực cạnh tranh trong khu vực và trên thế giới. Phát biểu về mục tiêu tổ chức cuộc thi, PGS.TS. Nguyễn Bình Minh, Viện trưởng Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số – Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, nhấn mạnh: “Mục tiêu của chúng tôi là xóa nhòa ranh giới giữa giảng đường và doanh nghiệp. Khi sinh viên được đưa vào môi trường áp lực cao để giải quyết những bài toán thực tiễn của các định chế tài chính lớn, đó chính là lúc năng lực đổi mới sáng tạo được phát huy mạnh mẽ nhất.

Lê Minh Hà – Giám đốc điều hành Viện Nghiên cứu cao cấp về Toán (VIASM) cho rằng dữ liệu và trí tuệ nhân tạo đang mở ra nhiều cơ hội mới cho đổi mới sáng tạo và phát triển kinh tế số. title: HỘI THẢO ECOTECH 2026 "DỮ LIỆU & AI: TỪ HẠ TẦNG ĐẾN GIÁ TRỊ THỰC TIỄN"
section: Dữ liệu và AI đang trở thành năng lực cạnh tranh cốt lõi

content:
[HỘI THẢO ECOTECH 2026 "DỮ LIỆU & AI: TỪ HẠ TẦNG ĐẾN GIÁ TRỊ THỰC TIỄN" > Xây dựng hệ sinh thái dữ liệu để phát triển kinh tế dữ liệu]
Mở đầu chương trình, bà Nguyễn Thị Ngọc Dung – Chánh Văn phòng Hiệp hội Dữ liệu Quốc gia trình bày tham luận “Xây dựng hệ sinh thái dữ liệu để phát triển kinh tế dữ liệu”. Theo bà Dung, Việt Nam hiện không thiếu dữ liệu khi Nhà nước, địa phương và doanh nghiệp đang sở hữu khối lượng dữ liệu rất lớn. Tuy nhiên, thách thức hiện nay không nằm ở việc tạo ra dữ liệu mà ở khả năng khai thác, kết nối và chuyển hóa dữ liệu thành giá trị. Kết quả khảo sát của Hiệp hội Dữ liệu Quốc gia cho thấy nhu cầu dữ liệu đã xuất hiện rõ ràng từ thị trường, đặc biệt trong các lĩnh vực logistics, tài chính, y tế, giáo dục và doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ. Diễn giả đề xuất mô hình Hệ sinh thái Kinh tế Dữ liệu Việt Nam gồm 5 tầng: Thể chế dữ liệu (Data Institution), Hạ tầng dữ liệu (Data Infrastructure), Tài nguyên dữ liệu (Data Resources), Công nghiệp dữ liệu (Data Industry) và Kinh tế dữ liệu (Data Economy). Trong đó, công nghiệp dữ liệu đóng vai trò trung tâm trong việc thu thập, chuẩn hóa, làm giàu, phân tích và thương mại hóa dữ liệu để tạo ra các sản phẩm, dịch vụ và giá trị kinh tế mới.

Tiếp nối chương trình, ông Đặng Minh Đức – đại diện MK Group trình bày tham luận “Chủ quyền dữ liệu và hạ tầng số quốc gia: Từ năng lực lõi đến giá trị thực tiễn”. Trong bài trình bày “AI và dữ liệu: Cơ hội từ sự trỗi dậy của những dữ liệu phi truyền thống trên thị trường tài chính và nền kinh tế”, TS. Hồ Quốc Tuấn – Giảng viên cao cấp Đại học Bristol (Vương quốc Anh) đã chia sẻ nhiều xu hướng mới trong khai thác dữ liệu phục vụ dự báo và ra quyết định. Theo TS. Hồ Quốc Tuấn, thị trường đang chứng kiến sự chuyển dịch từ các nguồn dữ liệu truyền thống như báo cáo tài chính hay số liệu thống kê sang các nguồn dữ liệu phi truyền thống như dữ liệu cảm biến, dữ liệu thu thập từ web, dữ liệu hành vi người dùng và dữ liệu mạng xã hội. Sự phát triển của AI và các mô hình học máy cho phép khai thác những nguồn dữ liệu này hiệu quả hơn, tạo ra nhiều cơ hội mới trong lĩnh vực tài chính, kinh tế và quản trị. Tuy nhiên, diễn giả cũng lưu ý rằng dữ liệu và mô hình chỉ là công cụ. Việc sử dụng dữ liệu phi truyền thống đặt ra nhiều thách thức như nguy cơ quá tập trung vào các tín hiệu ngắn hạn, bỏ sót những tín hiệu quan trọng có tần suất thấp hoặc gặp phải các thiên lệch trong dữ liệu và thuật toán.

[CONFERENCE ON DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND ECONOMY (ECOTECH 2026) “DATA & AI: FROM INFRASTRUCTURE TO REAL-WORLD VALUE”]
ECOTECH is an annual conference jointly organized by the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, and the Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM). The conference serves as a platform connecting academia, industry, and the technology community in the fields of data, AI, and digital transformation. In 2026, ECOTECH officially returns with the theme: “Data & AI: From Infrastructure to Real-World Value” As data is increasingly recognized as a new production asset of the digital economy under Resolution No. 57-NQ/TW, Vietnam has been actively advancing key national initiatives such as the National Population Database, Project 06, and the National AI Strategy toward 2030. However, building infrastructure is only the beginning. The greater challenge lies in transforming data and AI into tangible value in governance, production, and services. With the goal of fostering dialogue among academia, enterprises, the data community, and legal experts, ECOTECH 2026 will bring together leading scientists, industry leaders, and experts in data and artificial intelligence to discuss: National data and AI infrastructureAI applications in enterprises and real-world operationsTransforming data into economic valueLegal frameworks and data governance in the digital era

[BK FINTECH HACKDAY SEASON 9 – PITCHING DAY CONCLUDES WITH EXCITEMENT, EMOTIONS, AND EXPLOSIVE ENERGY]
CONGRATULATIONS TO THE TOP 2 TEAMS OF BK FINTECH HACKDAY SEASON 9 FOR COMPLETING THEIR PITCHING SESSION AT TASCO FOUNDRY: WASH3000 The Organizing Committee of BK Fintech Hackday would like to congratulate the two teams, WashBox24 and SmartCar Health, for successfully completing their live pitching session in front of Tasco’s leadership board as part of the Tasco Foundry: Wash3000 program. First Prize WashBox24 Project – An intelligent car care coordination platform that addresses the shortage of inner-city parking spaces by transforming parking time into car care time. Second Prize SmartCar Health Project – A Car Profile & AI Loyalty platform for Vietnam’s automotive ecosystem. From competing at BK Fintech Hackday to pitching in front of a major corporation, this marks a proud milestone and an important step forward in turning innovative ideas into real-world products. Beyond the opportunity to showcase their projects, the pitching session also provided both teams with practical insights, in-depth feedback, and valuable advice from Tasco’s leadership team — a rare and meaningful experience that not every competition can offer. The BK Fintech Hackday Organizing Committee would also like to express our sincere appreciation to our strategic partner Gen AI Fund for accompanying the program and creating such a valuable opportunity for young builders to gain real-world exposure, tackle large-scale challenges, and move closer to building their own startups. We wish WashBox24 and SmartCar Health continued passion and success as they further refine their models and advance on their product-building journey.

content:
[LAUNCH OF THE CYBER CLINICS INCUBATION PROGRAM FOR VIETNAM’S DIGITAL ECONOMY]
Representing The Asia Foundation, Ms. Anthea Mulakala, Senior Director for International Development Cooperation, highlighted that the Cyber Clinic is a practical solution as businesses increasingly face complex cybersecurity challenges. She also noted that the model is part of a regional network across 13 countries, enabling universities to share experiences and build a community of practice. Key activities of the program According to Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Thi Xuan Hoa, Vice Director of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, the program will be implemented from April 2026 to March 2027 across seven provinces and cities in Vietnam, including Hanoi, Quang Ninh, Dien Bien, Lao Cai, Thanh Hoa, Da Nang, and Can Tho. Key activities include: Establishing the Cyber Clinic model based on Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), supported by technical systemsDeveloping a training program on information security and risk managementTraining 80–100 students and trainees with a practice-oriented approachSupporting 200–300 enterprises in enhancing their information security capacitySelecting 10 outstanding participants for career development, while sharing the model through workshops and building a monitoring and evaluation framework The program will be implemented across multiple localities, expanding its impact and improving accessibility for the business community. Expected impact and long-term vision Through this initiative, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy aims to narrow the gap between education and real-world needs, while strengthening the information security capabilities of businesses during digital transformation.

[LAUNCHING CEREMONY OF THE CYBER CLINICS INCUBATION PROGRAM FOR VIETNAM'S DIGITAL ECONOMY]
Hanoi University of Science and Technology officially announces the launch of the Cyber Clinics Incubation Program for Vietnam's Digital Economy, funded by a non-refundable grant from The Asia Foundation (TAF). The project is implemented under the supervision of the Ministry of Education and Training, with a duration of 15 months from April 2026 to March 2027. It aims to develop a high-quality information security workforce aligned with the practical needs of the digital economy. Time: 09:30 – 13:00, April 16, 2026 Venue: HUST MB Digital Hub, Hanoi University of Science and Technology In the context of rapid digital transformation, many businesses especially micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) are facing increasing cybersecurity risks, while the supply of skilled information security professionals remains limited. In response, the program introduces the Cyber Clinics model at Hanoi University of Science and Technology, implemented by the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy. This model bridges academic training with real-world practice, enabling learners to gain hands-on experience while supporting businesses in addressing cybersecurity and digital risk management challenges. The program is expected to train approximately 80–100 students and trainees, while supporting 200–300 enterprises in strengthening their information security capacity and digital management. In parallel, it will develop technical systems, enhance training curricula, foster industry connections, and identify high-potential talents. Agenda The launching ceremony marks not only the official kickoff of the program but also provides a platform for dialogue among policymakers, experts, businesses, and academic institutions.

[WORKSHOP: APPLYING AI IN IDEA RESEARCH AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT > Program Overview]
As part of the supporting activities for participants of BK Fintech Hackday Batch 8, the workshop “Applying AI in Idea Research and Product Development” is organized to equip students with practical approaches and tools to effectively develop technology-driven ideas. The program addresses a common challenge faced by hackathon participants: how to move from an initial idea to a well-developed product within a limited timeframe. Through this workshop, participants will explore how AI can be applied across different stages of the product development process. Specifically, the workshop will focus on: • Applying AI in market research to identify user needs and key touchpoints • Using AI to rapidly design and develop product prototypes • Optimizing user experience through modern AI tools Beyond delivering knowledge, the workshop provides practical perspectives that help participants shorten development cycles and enhance their ability to turn ideas into competitive products in a hackathon environment. The program is expected to serve as a valuable support platform, enabling participants to approach BK Fintech Hackday Batch 8 with greater confidence while fostering innovation and the effective application of technology in practice.

[INSTITUTE FOR DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND ECONOMY BECOMES A MEMBER OF FISU VIETNAM, PROMOTING RESEARCH AND APPLICATION COLLABORATION]
Institute for Digital Technology and Economy has officially become a member of FISU Vietnam – the Club of Faculties, Schools, and Institutes of Information and Communication Technology in Vietnam. Joining FISU Vietnam not only affirms the Institute’s development orientation but also opens up new opportunities for collaboration with universities, research institutes, and enterprises in the field of information and communication technology. In the coming period, the Institute aims to strengthen scientific research activities while promoting the transfer and practical application of technological products, thereby contributing to addressing socio-economic challenges in the context of digital transformation. The membership certification ceremony was held as part of the FISU Vietnam Spring Gathering 2026. This annual event aims to review activities in 2025 and outline key priorities for 2026. The program brought together representatives from universities, research institutes, and enterprises, creating a platform for discussion and exchange on the development of human resources in artificial intelligence (AI) and digital technology. Through the event, member organizations discussed solutions to enhance training quality, promote applied research, and strengthen collaboration between academia and industry. This also represents an important step toward building and developing an innovation ecosystem in the technology sector in Vietnam. Joining FISU Vietnam is expected to enable the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy to expand its collaboration network, enhance research capacity, and generate greater practical value in the future.

[CONGRATULATIONS TO GRADUATES OF THE FINTECH K04 & BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE K01 PROGRAMS]
After a journey marked by dedication and continuous learning, students of the Fintech K04 and Business Intelligence K01 programs have successfully completed their studies. This milestone not only marks the completion of a training program but also opens a new chapter for pursuing opportunities in the digital era. Throughout the program, students were equipped with interdisciplinary knowledge at the intersection of finance, technology, and data, including Fintech, Blockchain, data analytics, and modern business thinking. Through hands-on projects and real-world business cases, students not only gained theoretical understanding but also developed the ability to apply knowledge in practice. For the Fintech program, students were introduced to core technologies shaping the modern financial industry, such as Blockchain, digital payments, digital banking, and AI applications in finance. They also developed systems thinking and gained insights into how technology is implemented in real-world financial business models. For the Business Intelligence program, students received structured training in data analysis, data visualization, and dashboard development for decision-making. The application of tools such as Power BI, combined with AI-assisted analytics, enabled students to transform data into valuable business insights. Graduation marks not only the result of sustained effort and perseverance but also the ability to adapt to rapidly evolving fields. Students are now well-prepared to enter the job market with a new mindset—flexible, technology-driven, and data-oriented. The Institute for Digital Technology and Economy congratulates all graduates and looks forward to their continued growth, innovation, and success in the future.

After a journey marked by dedication and perseverance, students of the Data Analysis K16 and K17 cohorts have successfully completed the program. From initial stages of unfamiliarity to confidently working with and analyzing data, this achievement represents an important milestone in their learning journey. Throughout the program, students have gradually mastered key tools such as SQL, Power BI, and Python, while developing a structured approach to data analysis. In addition to theoretical foundations, hands-on projects and dashboard development have enabled them to gain deeper insights and apply their knowledge in practical contexts. The graduation ceremony not only marks the completion of the program but also reflects the growth in both mindset and skillsets of the students. It serves as a solid foundation for them to confidently enter the job market and pursue opportunities in the data field. he Institute for Digital Technology and Economy extends its congratulations to all graduates and looks forward to seeing them continue to grow, innovate, and achieve further success in their future careers.

[CONFERENCE: “DIALOGUE ON THE AI SOCIETY – OPPORTUNITIES AND SOLUTIONS FOR VIETNAM 2026” > Event Information]
On Thursday, January 8, 2026, at Hall C2, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, VLAB Innovation, in collaboration with VietNamNet, organized the event “Dialogue on the AI Society – Opportunities and Solutions for Vietnam 2026.” The event served as a forum for in-depth discussions on the role of artificial intelligence in Vietnam’s socio-economic development in the coming period. The program aimed to clarify key societal issues in the AI era, from opportunities to drive growth and innovation to challenges related to governance, ethics, and social impacts. Through thematic dialogue sessions, the event was expected to propose practical solutions for the responsible development and application of AI, aligned with Vietnam’s context, thereby contributing to building a sustainable, human-centered AI ecosystem.

Timeline The event is expected to create a multi-dimensional dialogue space among academia, policymakers, and the technology community, contributing to shaping perspectives and solutions for the development of an AI-driven society in Vietnam in the years ahead.

SCIENTIFIC CONFERENCE AND LAUNCH OF THE VIETNAM DIGITAL ECONOMY REVIEW 2025: NEW DEVELOPMENT FRAMEWORKS FOR ADVANCING THE DIGITAL ECONOMY On January 16, 2026, at Hanoi University of Science and Technology, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy organized a scientific conference and officially launched the Vietnam Digital Economy Review 2025, under the theme: “New Development Frameworks for Advancing the Digital Economy.” The conference brought together policymakers, experts in economics and technology, business representatives, and academics to exchange insights and discuss the current state, challenges, and development directions of Vietnam’s digital economy in the coming period. Digital Economy – A New Growth Driver Amid Global Uncertainties In his opening remarks, Assoc. Prof. Huynh Dang Chinh, Vice President of Hanoi University of Science and Technology, emphasized that despite global economic fluctuations in 2025, Vietnam has maintained positive growth momentum. The digital economy contributed over 14% of GDP (approximately USD 72.1 billion). Vietnam is gradually shifting from outsourcing to innovation, and from consumption to technological mastery. In the coming period, achieving the target of the digital economy contributing around 30% of GDP by 2030 will be a significant challenge. This requires supplementing the current growth model with new drivers based on the knowledge economy, innovation, and the dual transformation of digital and green economies. Assoc. Prof.

Digital Economy – A Pillar of National Growth Strategy In his remarks at the conference, Prof. Hoang Van Cuong, Member of the 15th National Assembly and Member of the Institute Council of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, clarified three major issues facing the development of Vietnam’s digital economy, based on practical analysis and policy requirements. Although Vietnam’s digital economy has maintained a growth rate of around 17%, ranking among the highest in the region and being recognized as one of the most dynamic markets globally, a critical question remains: how much real value-added is retained within the domestic economy. Accurately assessing the contribution of the digital economy to GDP is therefore an urgent issue that requires further research and appropriate policy solutions. At the same time, the application of digital economy solutions, the development of national data platforms, and shared data infrastructure for key sectors such as healthcare and business are identified as foundational solutions to enhance governance efficiency, optimize resource allocation, and promote sustainable economic growth. According to Prof.

[DR. NGUYEN VAN CUONG PROPOSES SOLUTIONS TO ACHIEVE A MINIMUM GDP GROWTH RATE OF 10%]
In the article, Dr. Nguyen Van Cuong emphasizes that the appropriate approach to achieving 10% GDP growth is to improve the quality of growth, focusing on several key directions: • Placing labor productivity at the center of development policies • Increasing domestic value-added within production chains • Reducing financial risks and ensuring macroeconomic stability • Improving social welfare and environmental quality, aiming for sustainable development To achieve double-digit growth in the 2026–2035 period, Vietnam needs to implement synchronized institutional reforms, enhance the efficiency of resource utilization, and innovate its growth model. When these structural changes are carried out consistently, the goal of 10% GDP growth will have a real chance of becoming achievable rather than remaining merely an aspiration.

(Featured on Business Finance News – VTV1) Watch the full report at: https://vtvgo.vn/ts/Wzer61DpE9-20260325-238698 In the context of rising capital demand from businesses, while credit growth remains tightly controlled, digital assets are expected to serve as a new capital channel for the economy. Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Binh Minh noted that piloting digital asset markets, or Cryptocurrency exchanges, is an important first step in bringing this emerging sector from a “grey zone” into a formal legal framework. This would contribute to improving transparency in transactions. However, it should not be expected to generate a large volume of capital in the short term. At the same time, this pilot implementation will help establish fundamental mechanisms such as: • Asset custody mechanisms • Trading mechanisms • The development of a Fintech ecosystem based on digital assets and Digital Asset Exchange platforms in the near future

[ASSOC. PROF. NGUYEN BINH MINH SHARES INSIGHTS ON VTV1 BUSINESS FINANCE NEWS ON THE PILOT IMPLEMENTATION OF A DIGITAL ASSET EXCHANGE > CURRENT REGULATORY DEVELOPMENTS]
The Ministry of Finance has issued Circular No. 15/2026/TT-BTC, which requires: Organizations providing Cryptocurrency services must separately manage and account for customers’ funds and digital assets from their own. In addition, they must maintain detailed records of funds and digital assets by each customer and by each type of Cryptocurrency. However, these regulations still need further refinement to ensure the effective and practical operation of Digital Asset Exchange platforms.

[RECAP OF THE INTERNATIONAL TOFAS 2025–2026 AWARD CEREMONY]
On the morning of March 29, 2026, immediately following the final round, the Award Ceremony of the International TOFAS 2025–2026 officially took place at Hanoi University of Science and Technology, marking the successful conclusion of an exciting and inspiring season for more than 10,000 students nationwide. TOFAS 2025–2026 represents a significant milestone, as it is the first time the competition has integrated both Mathematics and Programming into a single season. This creates a more comprehensive academic platform aligned with the trends of digital-era education. After progressing through multiple rounds, from preliminary stages to the final round with over 1,600 outstanding contestants, the competition not only assessed students’ abilities but also helped them identify their strengths and better shape their future learning paths. The Award Ceremony was honored by the presence of distinguished leaders, experts, and business representatives, including: Assoc.Prof. Nguyen Binh Minh – Dean of Institute for Digital Technology and EconomyAssoc.Prof. Dr. Nguyen Thi Xuan Hoa – Vice Dean of Institute for Digital Technology and EconomyMr. Shinya Sayu – General Director of Global Partnership Division, SPRIX Education Group (Japan)Mr. Le Van Hoang – Chief Executive Officer of Kaopiz Holdings Joint Stock CompanyMr. Vu Ngoc Quan – Deputy Chief Executive Officer of Kaopiz Holdings Joint Stock CompanyMr. Yusuke Homma – General Director of SPRIX Vietnam Co., Ltd.Ms. Nguyen Thi Khue – Chief Executive Officer of Codestar Technology Training Joint Stock CompanyMr. Cao Van Thanh – Chief Technology Officer of Codestar Technology Training Joint Stock CompanyMs.

[HUST-TALENT PROJECT]
General Introduction The Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, is seeking candidates who are leading experts from Viet Nam and abroad to apply for positions under the HUST-Talent Project. HUST-Talent is part of the strategic orientation to develop Hanoi University of Science and Technology into a leading research university in the region, contributing to the realization of Resolution No. 71-NQ/TW on the central role of higher education in developing high-quality human resources and promoting innovation. The Institute for Digital Technology and Economy was established with the mission of becoming a leading research institute nationwide, contributing to the development of the digital economy and digital society through research, development, and application of Industry 4.0 technologies. The establishment of the Institute also contributes to enhancing Hanoi University of Science and Technology’s capacity for multidisciplinary science and technology collaboration, as well as sharing resources and facilities among research groups. At the time of its establishment, the Institute involved researchers and learners from three main units of Hanoi University of Science and Technology, including the School of Information and Communication Technology; the School of Economics and Management; and the Department of Mathematics and Informatics. Collaboration among research groups enables the resolution of complex problems requiring interdisciplinary approaches, arising from the fields of economics and finance, which demand the application of mathematical modeling and analysis while being implemented through information technology.

[THÔNG BÁO TUYỂN DỤNG THEO ĐỀ ÁN HUST-TALENT 2025–2030]
Giới thiệu chung Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số, Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội đang tìm kiếm các ứng viên là Chuyên gia đầu ngành trong và ngoài nước ứng tuyển vị trí theo Đề án HUST-Talent. HUST-Talent là một phần trong định hướng phát triển Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội trở thành đại học nghiên cứu hàng đầu khu vực, hiện thực hóa Nghị quyết 71-NQ/TW về vai trò trung tâm của giáo dục đại học trong phát triển nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao và đổi mới sáng tạo. Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số được thành lập với sứ mệnh trở thành đơn vị nghiên cứu hàng đầu cả nước, đóng góp vào công cuộc phát triển kinh tế số, xã hội số của quốc gia thông qua các công trình nghiên cứu, phát triển và ứng dụng công nghệ 4.0. Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số ra đời góp phần giúp Đại học Bách Khoa Hà Nội nâng cao khả năng hợp tác Khoa học công nghệ đa ngành, chia sẻ tài nguyên, cơ sở vật chất giữa các nhóm nghiên cứu. Ngay tại thời điểm thành lập, Viện có sự tham gia của các nhà nghiên cứu, người học từ ba đơn vị chính của Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, bao gồm Trường Công nghệ thông tin và Truyền thông; Trường Kinh tếvà Khoa Toán-Tin.

content:
[THÔNG BÁO TUYỂN DỤNG THEO ĐỀ ÁN HUST-TALENT 2025–2030]
Ngay tại thời điểm thành lập, Viện có sự tham gia của các nhà nghiên cứu, người học từ ba đơn vị chính của Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, bao gồm Trường Công nghệ thông tin và Truyền thông; Trường Kinh tếvà Khoa Toán-Tin. On the morning of December 5, 2025, at Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST), Institute for Digital Technology and Economy held a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signing ceremony with Kaopiz Holdings Joint Stock Company and SPRIX Inc.. The event marks an important milestone in expanding industry collaboration, developing digital human resources, and fostering an innovation ecosystem. Representatives from Hanoi University of Science and Technology: Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Dac Trung – Director of the Department of Partnership and EngagementAssoc. Prof. Nguyen Binh Minh – Dean of the Institute for Digital Technology and EconomyAssoc. Prof. Nguyen Thi Xuan Hoa – Vice Dean of the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy Along with faculty leaders and lecturers of the university. Representatives of SPRIX Inc. : Mr. Yusuke Homma – General Director, SPRIX VietnamMs. Kaylee Huyen Du – Operations DirectorMs. Lê Đỗ Hiểu Lâm – Admin Executive Representatives of Kaopiz Holdings Joint Stock Company: Mr. Le Van Hoang – General Director, Kaopiz HoldingsMs. Nguyen Thi Khue – General Director, Codestar Technology Training JSCMs. Le Hoang Anh – Business Director of SU5, Kaopiz HoldingsMr. Cao Van Thanh – Chief Technology Officer, Codestar Technology Training JSC Key Highlights of the Ceremony Opening the ceremony, Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Dac Trung – Head of External Affairs emphasized that the MOU establishes opportunities for practical cooperation between the university and enterprises. Through these partnerships, students can access new knowledge, work with industry experts, and strengthen their hands-on capabilities.

[MOU SIGNING CEREMONY BETWEEN THE INSTITUTE FOR DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND ECONOMY AND ETC]
On November 26, the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy – Hanoi University of Science and Technology – signed a Memorandum of Understanding with ETC Technology Systems Joint Stock Company, marking an important milestone in advancing the development of high-quality technology human resources. The signing ceremony was successfully held with the participation of: From the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, Hanoi University of Science and Technology: Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Binh Minh – Dean of the Institute for Digital Technology and EconomyAssoc. Prof. Nguyen Thi Xuan Hoa – Vice Dean of the Institute for Digital Technology and EconomyFaculty members from Hanoi University of Science and Technology From ETC Technology Systems Joint Stock Company: Mr. Ha Manh Hung – Vice Chairman at ETC Technology SystemsMr. Le Thanh Trung – Deputy General Director, ETCMr. Dang Thanh Tuan – Deputy General Director, EPAY Key discussion points at the ceremony During the ceremony, Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Binh Minh emphasized the importance of collaboration between academia and industry: “A strong and comprehensive partnership between the Institute and enterprises not only accelerates research and the transfer of cutting-edge technologies, but also enables students to gain early exposure to real-world applications.” Representatives from ETC reaffirmed that the cooperation will focus on establishing a two-way training model for high-quality human resources. The core objective is to ensure seamless integration between academic training and industry practice, equipping young professionals with hands-on skills, outstanding competitiveness, and a proactive mindset when entering the labour market.

[WEBINAR: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE – NỀN TẢNG CHUYỂN ĐỔI SỐ CHO DOANH NGHIỆP]
On November 12, the Institute for Digital Economy and Technology – Hanoi University of Science and Technology, in collaboration with Finxdemy – Technology Training and Consulting, organized the webinar “Business Intelligence – The Digital Transformation Platform for Enterprises,” attracting nearly 100 participants who were students, learners, and working professionals in the fields of technology, finance, and data. The speaker of the webinar, Dr. Pham Thi Nguyet Nga – Director of Data Governance and Analytics at OCB, and a Member of the Advisory Council of the Institute for Digital Economy and Technology, Hanoi University of Science and Technology – delivered an insightful, inspiring, and practical sharing about the development journey of Business Intelligence (BI) in enterprises. In her sharing, Dr. Nga helped participants gain a clearer understanding of: The BI Evolution: From Reporting to Intelligence – the shift from merely “reporting the past” to “predicting and automating the future.”BI as the foundation of digital transformation, helping enterprises make decisions more proactively, quickly, and accurately.BI is not only a tool but a data culture – where every decision is reflected through data.Case study: Customer Onboarding Process, illustrating how BI helps enterprises optimize processes and enhance customer experience through automation and real-time data analytics. Along with the message “Think big, do small & iterative” – Think big, start with small steps, and continually improve to create sustainable value from data.

Have you ever wondered: 💭 “What’s the real difference between school and work life?” 💭 “How can I communicate and collaborate effectively with colleagues in a professional, multi-generational environment?” You’ll find the answers at the Workshop “Workplace Vibes – Smart Ways to Communicate at Work”, co-organized by MB Bank and the Institute for Digital Technology and Economy, Hanoi University of Science and Technology. [HACK <CX> TOGETHER 2025 – Igniting Innovation and Bridging Academia with Industry in the Digital Banking Era]
Hanoi, June 21, 2025 – At the Digital Economy and Technology Conference – ECOTECH 2025, organized by the Institute for Digital Economy and Technology (BK Fintech) – Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST), HACK <CX> TOGETHER 2025 officially announced its winning teams and honored the most outstanding Customer Experience (CX) technology solutions in digital finance and banking. As AI and digital technologies are increasingly reshaping how businesses create value and serve customers, the competition aimed to foster meaningful collaboration between universities and businesses in search of practical innovation. HACK <CX> TOGETHER 2025 is a large-scale technology and innovation challenge designed to connect businesses, universities, and young tech talents to solve real-world problems in the finance–banking sector, with a strong focus on optimizing user experience in digital environments. The competition is co-organized by BK Fintech – HUST, Techcombank, and Lead Consulting, with strong support from major tech partners including AWS, Centic, AI4LIFE, BK Entrepreneurship Center, and the HUST Youth Union, along with nearly 60 experts and mentors from academia and industry. With a customer-centric approach, the challenge topics were designed based on real business needs from a leading bank, covering areas such as: AI-generated financial content, real-time fraud detection, ESG spending scoring, loan approval classification, personalized digital banking experiences, risk forecasting and portfolio management, customer journey analysis and AI-powered touchpoint optimization, and credit scoring for crypto users.

With a customer-centric approach, the challenge topics were designed based on real business needs from a leading bank, covering areas such as: AI-generated financial content, real-time fraud detection, ESG spending scoring, loan approval classification, personalized digital banking experiences, risk forecasting and portfolio management, customer journey analysis and AI-powered touchpoint optimization, and credit scoring for crypto users. Over seven days, teams worked closely with nearly 60 industry experts from Techcombank, HUST, Lead Consulting, AWS, and other partners to refine their ideas. They then advanced to the 36-hour Hackathon Round, where they coded, designed, and presented their solutions with ongoing expert guidance, turning ideas into real, testable prototypes. From this intensive and creative journey, the 6 best teams were selected to advance to the Final Round, held within ECOTECH 2025 – an event bringing together leading enterprises, tech experts, and top universities across Vietnam.

title: Workshop Data Analytics in Marketing

content:
[Workshop Data Analytics in Marketing > Speakers & Contents]
Mr. Dang Tran Duc Minh (Co-founder, Director of Marketing & Business Development, LEAD Consulting) offered a comprehensive overview of how data drives modern marketing—from analyzing customer behavior to forecasting market trends. Notably, he introduced the Marketing Mix Modelling approach, a powerful tool for optimizing marketing budgets, identifying the most effective media channels, and measuring the impact of each marketing element on sales performance. Mr. Do Hoang Minh (Data Analyst, LEAD Consulting) shared practical techniques for data visualization and customer segmentation models such as RFM and K-Means. These models help businesses unlock the full potential of their data, enhance advertising strategies, and improve customer experience. [Workshop Data Analytics in E-commerce]
On the afternoon of August 4, 2024, BK Fintech successfully hosted the Workshop: Data Analytics in E-commerce, featuring an insightful session on AI and Big Data applications in the e-commerce industry. The workshop was led by Mr. Tran Minh Tuan, Co-founder and CEO of Data Science JSC, the company behind Metric – a pioneering platform for e-commerce data intelligence in Vietnam.
raw: On the afternoon of August 4, 2024, BK Fintech successfully hosted the Workshop: Data Analytics in E-commerce, featuring an insightful session on AI and Big Data applications in the e-commerce industry. The workshop was led by Mr. Tran Minh Tuan, Co-founder and CEO of Data Science JSC, the company behind Metric – a pioneering platform for e-commerce data intelligence in Vietnam.
title: Workshop Data Analytics in E-commerce

content:
[Workshop Data Analytics in E-commerce > Speaker & Content]
In the first part of the session, Mr. Tuan introduced foundational concepts and key AI problems, including Classification, Regression, Structured Prediction, Clustering, Reinforcement Learning, Text Generation. These concepts form the foundation for understanding real-world AI applications, especially within the e-commerce landscape. In the second part, he provided deeper insights into the integration of AI and Big Data in customer data analysis. A highlight was the practical application of the RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) model, showcasing how data helps e-commerce businesses segment customers and optimize marketing strategies effectively.

Mô tả: Cuộc thi là cơ hội cho cá nhân và đội thi thuyết trình ý tưởng sáng tạo của mình trong lĩnh vực Công nghệ tài chính (Fintech) trước các chuyên gia, quỹ đầu tư và doanh nghiệp. Từ đó, người tham gia sẽ nhận những ý kiến đóng góp và cơ hội quý giá để phát triển sản phẩm trong tương lai. Bên cạnh đó, những dự án xuất sắc sẽ nhận được phần thưởng có giá trị bằng tiền mặt và hỗ trợ ươm mầm phát triển sản phẩm tới từ các đơn vị đồng hành cuộc thi. Chủ đề: Các ứng dụng, sản phẩm trong lĩnh vực Công nghệ tài chính, Kinh tế số. Bài dự thi có thể chỉ là một ý tưởng còn chưa được phát triển. Cuộc thi cũng không có hạn chế về công nghệ sử dụng. Sau cuộc thi, các ý tưởng, sản phẩm tiềm năng sẽ được Đơn vị tổ chức và Đơn vị đồng hành hỗ trợ phát triển. Hình thức bài thi: Các cá nhân và nhóm gửi bài dự thi qua Google form bên dưới. Sau vòng sơ loại, các đội được lựa chọn sẽ được mời thuyết trình trước Ban giám khảo, đại diện các Quỹ đầu tư, và doanh nghiệp. Các đội thi ở xa có thể trình bày trực tuyến. Đối tượng tham gia: Người Việt Nam, đang học tập, sinh sống, làm việc tại Việt Nam và nước ngoài.

content:
[CUỘC THI BKFINTECH HACKDAY LẦN THỨ I NĂM 2024]
Trung tâm Công nghệ và Kinh tế số (BKFintech) và Công ty Cổ phần Oraichain Labs phối hợp tổ chức cuộc thi “BKFintech Hackday” lần thứ I, năm 2024, cụ thể như sau: I. NỘI DUNG CUỘC THI 1. Nội dung cuộc thi Triển khai dApp AMM ứng dụng Uniswap v3 trên Oraichain mainnet 2. Tiêu chí hoàn thành - Giao diện swap có thể kết nối ví Owallet / Keplr / Leap - Users cung cấp thanh khoản theo khoảng giá cho các cặp tokens - Users có thể swap các tokens được cung cấp thanh khoản ở trên - Sản phẩm có thể triển khai dạng widget để dễ tích hợp (Ví dụ triển khai trên OraiDEX) 3. Tham khảo & Lưu ý Tham khảo mô tả tại https://blog.uniswap.org/uniswap-v3 - Uniswap v3 White Paper - Link - Uniswap v3 Core - Link Lưu ý - dApp trên Oraichain ứng dụng Cosmos SDK. Có thể tham khảo các sản phẩm đã có, ứng dụng AMM v3 sử dụng Cosmos SDK II. ĐỐI TƯỢNG DỰ THI Người Việt Nam, đang học tập, sinh sống, làm việc tại Việt Nam (ưu tiên các đội thi có sinh viên tham gia) - Đã biết về blockchain (EVM, Rust,…) - Có thể biết hoặc chưa biết về Cosmos SDK - Mong muốn phát triển ứng dụng dApp tiếp cận được với người dùng thật III. ĐĂNG KÝ THAM GIA CUỘC THI 1. Thời hạn đăng ký: hết ngày 09/5/2024 2.

[CUỘC THI BKFINTECH HACKDAY LẦN THỨ I NĂM 2024]
Kinh phí giải thưởng do Công ty Cổ phần Oraichain Labs gửi cho cá nhân hoặc đại diện nhóm tác giả trong vòng tối đa 30 ngày làm việc sau khi Lễ trao giải được tổ chức. Đội thi đạt giải phải chịu trách nhiệm về khoản thuế thu nhập hoặc lệ phí liên quan đến giải thưởng (nếu có) theo quy định của pháp luật Việt Nam hiện hành. VI. QUY ĐỊNH KHÁC - Sản phẩm dự thi không phải là đối tượng tranh chấp bản quyền tác giả. - Các đội thi phải chịu trách nhiệm về sở hữu trí tuệ của sản phẩm, sự chính xác của thông tin trong hồ sơ cung cấp cho Ban Tổ chức. - Ban Tổ chức được quyền sử dụng các thông tin về đội thi và dự án trong công tác truyền thông; được quyền chụp ảnh, quay phim, ghi âm lại trong quá trình tổ chức. - Trong quá trình tổ chức Cuộc thi, nếu gặp những vấn đề phát sinh ngoài quy định của Thể lệ này, Ban tổ chức sẽ xem xét sửa đổi, bổ sung cho phù hợp với tình hình thực tiễn và thông báo tới các đơn vị, các đội thi.

title: LỄ KÝ KẾT TÀI TRỢ CÁC DỰ ÁN NGHIÊN CỨU KHOA HỌC

content:
[LỄ KÝ KẾT TÀI TRỢ NGHIÊN CỨU KHOA HỌC]
Sáng ngày 10/05/2024, Lễ ký kết tài trợ các dự án nghiên cứu khoa học giữa Trung tâm Công nghệ và Kinh tế số - Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội (BK Fintech) và các Chủ nhiệm đề tài đã diễn ra tại Tòa HUST - MB Digital Hub. Thông qua hợp tác với Công ty cổ phần Rikkeisoft, Trung tâm đã ký kết tài trợ cho 06 dự án nghiên cứu khoa học về chủ đề Kinh tế số, thực hiện từ 5/2024 tới 5/2025, với tổng kinh phí hơn 1.5 tỷ đồng. Tại Lễ ký kết, PGS. TS Trương Việt Anh - Trưởng Ban Khoa học - Công nghệ, Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội đã có phát biểu chỉ đạo và khẳng định rằng các dự án nghiên cứu khoa học được ký kết tài trợ lần này sẽ góp phần quan trọng trong việc phát triển nghiên cứu khoa học của Đại học. PGS cũng thể hiện sự tin tưởng vào mối quan hệ hợp tác giữa Rikkeisoft và BKFintech sẽ bền chặt, đem lại lợi ích cho cả hai bên. Trong buổi Lễ, Ông Đặng Thái Hoà - Tổng Giám đốc Công ty cổ phần Rikkeisoft cũng đã chia sẻ mục đích và ý nghĩa của việc hợp tác, tài trợ nghiên cứu khoa học. Một mặt, tập thể lãnh đạo Rikkeisoft vốn là các cựu sinh viên của Đại học Bách Khoa Hà Nội, nên mong muốn đóng góp, hỗ trợ Nhà trường.

title: LỄ KÝ KẾT TÀI TRỢ NGHIÊN CỨU KHOA HỌC

[LỄ KÝ KẾT TÀI TRỢ NGHIÊN CỨU KHOA HỌC]

title: CÔNG BỐ 8 ĐỘI THI VÀO VÒNG CHUNG KẾT FINTECH INNOVATION COMPETITION 2024

content:
[HỘI THẢO ECOTECH VÀ CUỘC THI FINTECH INNOVATION]
Vào ngày thứ 7, 15/6/2024, tại Đại học Bách Khoa Hà Nội, Trung tâm Công nghệ và Kinh tế số (BK Fintech) phối hợp cùng Viện nghiên cứu cao cấp về Toán (VIASM), quỹ IDG Blockchain Việt Nam, và Trung tâm sáng tạo và Khởi nghiệp sinh viên tổ chức thành công hai sự kiện, đó là: Hội thảo quốc tế lần thứ nhất về Công nghệ và Kinh tế số (International Conference on Digital Technology and Economy - EcoTech) và Cuộc thi Fintech Innovation 2024. Tại hội thảo, người tham dự đã được lắng nghe, trao đổi các nghiên cứu mới nhất tới từ các nhà khoa học xuất sắc như GS. Lim Kian Guan (Đại học Quản lý Singapore), TS. Thắng Hoàng (Đại học Viginia Tech, Mỹ), PGS. Nguyễn Xuân Hoài (Viện trưởng AI Academy), cũng như được cập nhật những xu hướng nghiên cứu và ứng dụng nổi bật trong lĩnh vực Fintech như trí tuệ nhân tạo, tài chính định lượng, v.v. Tại cuộc thi, 8 đội thi xuất sắc được chọn từ 34 đội thi nộp bài, đã có vòng trình bày cuốn hút, hấp dẫn trước hội đồng BGK, bao gồm 5 chuyên gia uy tín, là các Giám đốc, Phó Giám đốc các đơn vị, doanh nghiệp trong lĩnh vực Fintech. Kết quả, đội Spine Finace gồm 2 sinh viên đang học tập tại Mỹ đã xuất sắc đạt Giải Nhất với giải pháp Spine Protocol đầy hứa hẹn.

[HỘI THẢO: NÂNG CAO NĂNG SUẤT LAO ĐỘNG VÀ CHẤT LƯỢNG TRONG KỶ NGUYÊN SỐ]
Cường là tiến sĩ lĩnh vực Kinh tế học, với trình độ lý luận chính trị cao cấp, và từng là Phó Trưởng ban Ban Quản lý Khu Công nghệ cao Hoà Lạc (Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ). Ông có nhiều kinh nghiệm trong quản lý khoa học công nghệ, triển khai khu công nghệ cao, hoạch định và triển khai các chính sách quản lý quỹ bảo hiểm xã hội. TS. Cường đã góp phần quan trọng vào việc cải cách và hiện đại hóa hệ thống bảo hiểm xã hội tại Việt Nam, hướng tới nâng cao chất lượng phục vụ người dân và cải thiện hiệu quả quản lý trong lĩnh vực này. 3. Bà Vũ Hồng Dân - Trưởng phòng Tư vấn Cải tiến Năng suất, Viện Năng suất Việt Nam, Ủy ban Tiêu chuẩn Đo lường chất lượng Quốc Gia Bà Vũ Hồng Dân hiện là Trưởng phòng Tư vấn Cải tiến Năng suất tại Viện Năng suất Việt Nam. Với 28 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực giảng dạy và tư vấn cải tiến năng suất, bà là chuyên gia hàng đầu tại nhiều lĩnh vực trong các tổ chức như: chuyên gia của Tổ chức Năng suất Châu Á (APO) về Quản lý tri thức, cải tiến năng suất chất lượng, Chuyên gia đánh giá chứng nhận phê duyệt năng lực thuộc chương trình chứng nhận chuyên gia năng suất của Việt Nam.

[HỘI THẢO: NÂNG CAO NĂNG SUẤT LAO ĐỘNG VÀ CHẤT LƯỢNG TRONG KỶ NGUYÊN SỐ]
Với 28 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực giảng dạy và tư vấn cải tiến năng suất, bà là chuyên gia hàng đầu tại nhiều lĩnh vực trong các tổ chức như: chuyên gia của Tổ chức Năng suất Châu Á (APO) về Quản lý tri thức, cải tiến năng suất chất lượng, Chuyên gia đánh giá chứng nhận phê duyệt năng lực thuộc chương trình chứng nhận chuyên gia năng suất của Việt Nam. Bên cạnh đó, bà còn là đánh giá trưởng ISO 9001 do cơ quan Công nhận Quốc tế Moody (Anh Quốc) công nhận. Bà từng là chuyên gia tư vấn trưởng của các dự án tư vấn cho các doanh nghiệp lớn như PVN, Rạng Đông, SHB, và các bệnh viện hàng đầu Việt Nam (Bệnh viện Việt Đức, bệnh viện TWQĐ 108, bệnh viện Chợ Rẫy..). Đồng thời, bà cũng là tác giả của nhiều cuốn sách về quản lý tri thức và Lean trong doanh nghiệp, góp phần phổ biến và ứng dụng các mô hình cải tiến hiện đại tại Việt Nam. 4. TS. content:
[HỘI THẢO: NÂNG CAO NĂNG SUẤT LAO ĐỘNG VÀ CHẤT LƯỢNG TRONG KỶ NGUYÊN SỐ]
Hướng quan tâm chính của TS. Lâm là ứng dụng công nghệ chữ ký số và blockchain trong lĩnh vực giáo dục. title: HỘI THẢO: NÂNG CAO NĂNG SUẤT LAO ĐỘNG VÀ CHẤT LƯỢNG TRONG KỶ NGUYÊN SỐ

content:
[TỔNG KẾT HỘI THẢO: NÂNG CAO NĂNG SUẤT LAO ĐỘNG VÀ CHẤT LƯỢNG TRONG KỶ NGUYÊN SỐ]
Sáng ngày 11/1, Hội thảo "Nâng cao năng suất lao động và chất lượng trong kỷ nguyên số" đã diễn ra thành công tại Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội. Hội thảo được phối hợp tổ chức bởi 3 đơn vị: Viện Công nghệ và Kinh tế số (Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội), Viện Chủ nghĩa Xã hội Khoa học (Học viện Chính trị quốc gia Hồ Chí Minh) và Viện Năng suất Việt Nam - dựa trên tinh thần của Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW của Bộ Chính trị về đột phá phát triển khoa học, công nghệ, đổi mới sáng tạo và chuyển đổi số quốc gia, Quyết định số 36/QĐ-TTg của Thủ tướng Chính phủ ban hành Kế hoạch tổng thể nâng cao năng suất dựa trên nền tảng khoa học, công nghệ và đổi mới sáng tạo giai đoạn 2021 - 2030. Phát biểu khai mạc hội thảo, PGS. Huỳnh Quyết Thắng - Giám đốc Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội hoan nghênh sáng kiến tổ chức hội thảo của 3 đơn vị và tin tưởng rằng, thông qua hội thảo, các chuyên gia, nhà khoa học sẽ cùng đưa ra những giải pháp hữu ích khơi dậy tinh thần sáng tạo của sinh viên, khát vọng cống hiến của nhà nghiên cứu, cùng cống hiến cho kỷ nguyên vươn mình của dân tộc.

[V-Chain]
A platform that supports programmers in developing and deploying decentralized applications on a variety of existing blockchain networks. Exploding in early 2018, Blockchain has become one of the technologies that has changed the world. The development of technology, leading to the birth of many blockchain networks such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Avalanche, etc., makes programmers need more time to research on technology and develop decentralized applications - this is also the reason for the birth of the V-Chain platform.

title: V-Chain

content:
[V-Chain > What is V-Chain?]
V-Chain is a platform that supports programmers in developing and deploying decentralized applications on a variety of existing blockchain networks. Currently, the programming time for decentralized applications can last up to several months, but with V-Chain, this time can be shortened to just a few days. V-Chain allows users to easily define application operations, the roles of actors, as well as the data they want to write to a specific blockchain network. From there, V-Chain generates APIs/SDKs to support programmers in communicating with the blockchain network. The platform also supports the deployment of applications, or even a private blockchain network. The V-Chain platform has an overall architecture of 04 layers, respectively: blockchain network, core services, utility services, service portal and APIs. 1. Blockchain Network V-Chain is designed to support a variety of blockchain networks including public and private networks such as Hyperledger Sawtooth, Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum, etc. This allows users to deploy a node in the network themselves, or create a private blockchain to increase security and make transactions quickly. 2. Core Services The purpose of core services is to enable upper layers to communicate with underlying blockchain networks in a unified and easy way.

content:
[V-Chain > What is V-Chain?]
Some notable core services include: Smart contract: V-Chain uses a common, consistent format for users to generate smart contracts for different blockchain platforms.Data model: defines a unified model for storing data on the blockchain network.Resource management: to connect and distribute resources to applications, and to keep logs from nodes, service and application read and write operations at upper layers. 3. Utility Services Utility services are developed to support the deployment of decentralized applications in companies, organizations and governments. The services will help blockchainize the organization's existing operations. Some of the services on the V-Chain platform currently include: V-Engine: Users can choose which blockchain network to record data on such as Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum or IPFS, or create their own blockchainV-Mapping: Users define the data stored on the chain, the relationship between the dataV-Trace: Users can retrieve data on the network and display it on their applications.V-Storage: is a decentralized storage service based on IPFS technologyV-Monitoring: A service that helps users monitor the status of transactions, nodes and the entire blockchain network.V-Token: A service that automatically deploys tokens for the blockchain network in the V-Chain ecosystem. 4. Service Portals and APIs V-Chain provides the main communication method through REST API and Web/Portal. The V-Chain platform was born to provide a new and effective solution for the development and deployment of decentralized applications. The platform contributes to promoting the application of blockchain technology in current activities, to bring service quality and trust to users.

content:
[BKSign]
Remote signing solution The Problem: As technology develops, working from home and remote work have become increasingly common. As a result, organizations and institutions are required to send documents in PDF format more frequently. This leads to a common issue: PDF documents often lack the signature of the creator or an authorized person, reducing the authenticity of the document. Printing out documents for manual signing is time-consuming and labor-intensive. To address this, digital signatures were introduced. However, traditional methods like USB tokens or smart cards have shown limitations in today's context: high costs, inconvenience due to the need to carry physical signing devices, and suboptimal security. Remote Signing: Remote signing is emerging as the next generation of digital signatures. It overcomes the limitations of traditional methods by freeing users from having to carry physical signing devices. With just familiar devices like smartphones, tablets, or laptops, users can securely and conveniently sign digital documents.

content:
[BKSign > BKSign - Internal Digital Signing Solution]
The BKSign internal digital signing solution, developed by the BKFintech team, addresses internal document management challenges faced by institutions and organizations — such as the need to sign various documents, certificates, diplomas, and having multiple signers with high volume, all while keeping deployment costs low. To achieve this, BKSign has implemented an internal Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) to issue internal digital certificates to users within the organization, instead of requiring users to purchase costly public digital certificates. Key Features of BKSign: Builds a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) to issue and manage internal digital certificates (X.509 standard)Enables remote signing directly on PDF, Word, and Excel filesAvailable as mobile and web applications for easy accessLow cost, ideal for organizations with many internal documents requiring signing and circulationIntegrates with public remote signing systems such as VNPT and ViettelSupports SIM-based digital signatures (e.g., Viettel, MobiFone) and USB-based signatures via the BKSign USB Plugin Additional Features of BKSign: Manage lists of digital signing accounts (both internal and public)Insert signature images (image or handwritten) and text into PDF filesView the signing history of documentsVerify internal digital signatures in documentsSign MS Word and MS Excel files

content:
[eDiploma]
A complete solution for issuing and verifying digital certificates The Problem: Diplomas, certificates, and attestations are credentials typically issued by educational institutions or organizations to learners upon completion of a specific training program. Traditionally, these credentials are issued once in paper form, containing information about the learner, the training program, and the signature of the head of the issuing organization. As such, they are special documents of great significance and importance, meant to be carefully preserved for life. Today, fake diplomas and certificates have become a growing issue in society. With minimal cost, individuals can easily obtain counterfeit documents that are marketed as difficult to detect. The verification process for these credentials is often lengthy, inconvenient, and potentially costly, allowing fake documents to persist in our society. To address this problem, it is essential to provide learners with an additional digital credential that contains authenticated information and is easy to verify.

title: eDiploma

content:
[eDiploma > Our Solution]
eDiploma is a powerful solution that enables organizations and educational institutions to issue digital versions of diplomas, certificates and credentials. These digital documents are legally valid and easy to verify. Powered by digital signature technology, eDiploma ensures the authenticity of the signer and the integrity of the document. Key Features of eDiploma: High-speed digital signing: eDiploma’s digital signing system stands out with its exceptional signing speed, capable of processing 15,000 files per minute, meeting the demand for high-volume digital signing in a short period of time. This is especially crucial for events where a large number of certificates need to be issued immediately upon completion — such as the TSA (Thinking Skills Assessment) exams or various training and certification programs.High-volume certificate processing: With its batch digital signing capability, the system can process thousands of certificates in a single session without interruption or overload. This enables organizations to efficiently handle large batches of certifications, minimizing processing time while ensuring accuracy and consistency for every certificate issued.Flexible signing integrations: The system also supports a wide range of digital signing methods, allowing integration with multiple Certificate Authorities (CAs). This flexibility enables users to choose the signing method that best fits the specific requirements and conditions of their organization.Intuitive and user-friendly interface: eDiploma offers a convenient and intuitive certificate template configuration feature, with a simple setup process and the ability to reuse previously created templates.

[BKOffice]
Comprehensive Document Management System for Universities Product Overview: - BKOffice is a document management system specifically designed for higher education institutions, developed by Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST). - The platform strictly adheres to Government Decree No. 30/2020/NĐ-CP on clerical and administrative procedures. - BKOffice fully digitizes the workflows of document handling, task management, and record archiving across the entire university. More than just a replacement for existing software, BKOffice is an enhanced solution tailored to the operational requirements of each university — from document intake, task processing, digital signing, to records management — all performed on a unified, user-friendly, and secure platform.
